shortDescription: Manage Web Filter Policies (Protect > Web > Policies)

options.name: default_action
options.description: Default action of the policy.

options.name: description
options.description: Specify Policy description. Max 255 chars.

options.name: download_file_size_restriction
options.description: Specify maximum allowed file download size in MB (0-1536).

options.name: download_file_size_restriction_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable checking for maximum allowed file download size.

options.name: enable_reporting
options.description: Select to enable reporting of policy.

options.name: enforce_image_licensing
options.description: Enable or disable limiting search results to Creative Commons licensed images.

options.name: enforce_safe_search
options.description: Enable or disable blocking of pornography and explicit content in search results.

options.name: goog_app_domain_list
options.description: Comma-separated list of domains allowed to access Google services. Max 256 chars.

options.name: goog_app_domain_list_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable specifying domains for Google services.

options.name: name
options.description: Specify a name for the Web Filter Policy.

options.name: office_365_directory_id
options.description: Domain ID allowed to access the Microsoft 365 service. Max 50 chars.

options.name: office_365_enabled
options.description: Turn on or off specifying domains/IDs for Microsoft 365.

options.name: office_365_tenants_list
options.description: Comma-separated list of domain names and domain IDs allowed to access Microsoft 365. Max 4096 chars.

options.name: quota_limit
options.description: Maximum allowed time (1-1440 minutes) for browsing restricted web content under quota policy action.

options.name: rule_action
options.description: Action for rules when updating policies ('add' or 'replace'). To remove rules, use 'replace' with the new complete list.

options.name: rules
options.description: Specify the rules contained in this policy.

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(query) to retrieve, C(present) to create, C(updated) to modify, or C(absent) to remove

options.name: xff_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable X-Forwarded-For header.

options.name: youtube_filter_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable YouTube Restricted Mode.

options.name: youtube_filter_is_strict
options.description: Adjust the policy used for YouTube Restricted Mode (true for strict, false for moderate).
